show.description: In the misty highlands of Kerala, a routine missing-persons case takes a sinister turn. As one cop follows the trail, he unearths a pattern of horror that links the living to the lost. Kerala Police Diary — a haunting investigative thriller where every clue brings you closer to the predator hiding in plain sight.
